# DeepSeek Harness Benchmark

Purpose: deterministic repository-level evaluation of complete model-harness configurations.

Primary agent instructions: ./AGENTS.md
Human overview in Chinese: ./README.zh-CN.md
Human overview in English: ./README.md
Task authoring: ./docs/authoring.md
Run protocol: ./docs/operations.md
Metrics contract: ./docs/metrics.md
Chinese docs: ./docs/zh-CN/
Public datasets: ./datasets/
Public development evaluators (workspace-hidden, not sealed): ./private/hidden-tests/
Development reference solutions (not sealed evidence): ./private/reference-solutions/
Result schemas: ./schemas/

Critical boundary: never copy or expose ./private to an evaluated agent. Prepare an isolated workspace with `harnessbench prepare`, stop the agent, then evaluate externally.
Sealed boundary: keep true selection and final-confidence evaluators outside repositories and environments accessible to the tested agent until the comparison finishes.
Run modes: use one-shot probe mode for development; predeclare all repetitions and comparison rules for confirm mode before seeing outcomes.
ShipReady gates: every capability named in `required_capabilities` must earn its full weight.
Decision order: invalid/critical failures, ShipReady count, completion, optimization quality, then time/tokens/credits among similarly complete runs.

Canonical checks:
1. `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m harnessbench validate datasets/minimal-3`
2. `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
3. `git diff --check`
